title: School dress rules at Taiwan's senior high schools (background for two student opinion letters)

sources.title: Dress rule eased at senior high, vocational schools (2016-08-19)
sources.license: Taipei Times terms of use (facts only)

sources.title: Students not required to have names on uniforms (2022-06-16)
sources.license: Taipei Times terms of use (facts only)

facts.text: Since 2016, Taiwan's Ministry of Education has barred senior high and vocational schools from giving students demerits for wearing clothes the school has not approved.
Under the 2016 rules, students wear sports uniforms for physical education classes and regular uniforms at school ceremonies and formal events.
Under the 2016 rules, students may wear their own coats over their uniforms when it is cold.
The approved school clothing is to be decided through open discussion among administrators, teachers and students.
In 2022 the ministry said students' names no longer had to appear on school uniforms, after complaints that students had been harassed by strangers who saw their names.

notes: 兩篇投書是虛構學生的意見文；文中的事實只用上列制度背景。
